title: vitex lucens
intro: Vitex lucens, commonly known as Blue Chaste Tree, is a flowering plant species in the Verbenaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in supporting women's health, with reported health benefits including relief from menstrual cramps, hot flashes, and anxiety. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Vitex lucens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal effects.
